progressiveDisclosure: Framework route, transaction, owner, provider, and evidence

prompt.primaryRequest: Create an original shippable visual concept called Topology Observatory: an interactive observatory for deterministic information flows rather than a generic developer-docs template.
prompt.composition: One dominant desktop Landing frame with legible mobile, documentation, and Runtime Atlas insets on a deep graphite coordinate plane.
prompt.narrative: INFORMATION, EXECUTED. with working-product and Framework-learning entrances.
prompt.semantics: UI intent to App Feature and API, then an orange transaction boundary around Factory and canonical owners, followed by UI projection; Preset and Provider remain dashed optional composition; future runtime is outside the active route.
prompt.constraints: CSS-feasible geometry, accessible contrast, visible focus, readable mobile and documentation states, no external assets, no generic card grid, no glassmorphism, no unsupported Core Kernel claim.

strengths: strong Runtime Atlas and engineering-depth language
clear current, optional, transaction, accepted, and roadmap marks
credible dark shell plus warm reading surface
risks: above-the-fold narrative expects more technical literacy than the global audience contract permits
dense topology should appear after the plain-language value layer

prompt.primaryRequest: Create an original shippable visual concept called Material Blueprint that lets a worldwide non-engineer understand Asyra before progressively revealing the technical Framework.
prompt.composition: A global editorial Landing sheet with warm mineral paper, architectural registration marks, one continuous world-building fold, and mobile, documentation, and Runtime Atlas insets.
prompt.narrative: BUILD THE TOOL YOUR WORLD NEEDS. You define the knowledge. Asyra keeps every action clear, safe, and reversible. Whiteboard, BIM, VR, and simulation remain App-owned examples.
prompt.semantics: DESCRIBE to ACT to VERIFY, then Feature to API to transaction-bounded owners to projection; indigo canonical route, violet optional route, vermilion transaction, green accepted state, cross-hatched verified roadmap boundary.
prompt.constraints: Plain international English first, localized-text resilience, 44px touch intent, long-form reading, shapes plus color, no external assets, no SaaS card grid, no invented roadmap items.

strengths: concrete possibilities remain explicitly App-owned examples
strong mobile and long-form reading hierarchy
technical depth arrives through progressive disclosure
warm material identity is distinctive yet implementable
risks: illustrated possibility panorama must be rebuilt as code-native line work rather than shipped as raster
technical blue annotation density must be reduced at narrow widths

prompt.primaryRequest: Create an original shippable visual concept called Signal Ledger: a living ledger where knowledge becomes controlled, observable action.
prompt.composition: A bold narrative column beside a continuous event ledger, with mobile, long-form documentation, and active/failure Runtime Atlas insets.
prompt.narrative: FROM KNOWLEDGE TO ACTION. You bring the domain. Asyra brings the structure for safe, reversible action. Name what matters, define what can happen, and see every outcome.
prompt.semantics: Idea, action, check, and result precede expandable Feature, API, transaction, owner, projection, and evidence details; accepted, optional, failure, and roadmap states use shape and text as well as color.
prompt.constraints: Plain international English, localization resilience, 44px touch intent, light reading surface, no external assets, no generic dashboard or card grid, current examples separated from roadmap.

strengths: best active, optional, failure, and roadmap state differentiation
plain and technical evidence views coexist
strong source for Runtime Atlas timeline and motion
risks: ledger density can overload the Landing page
large condensed type and technical rows require careful localization behavior
